column1: # sq-core-time oracle: text-tables.tsv. Columns are TAB separated. `# ` lines are comments. Strings = quoted, scalars outside 0x20-0x7E, `\` and `"` as \u{hex}.
# Recorded with Locale.current = en_US (process started with -AppleLocale en_US -AppleLanguages (en)).
# LCG for the sampled pairs: see ops.tsv header. seed = 20261105, pool order as in swift-dump/main.swift.

# standard_compare <a> <b> -> A B  : A = `a.localizedStandardCompare(b)` (Finder-style, what Bin/MediaGrouping use), B = `a.compare(b, options: [.numeric, .caseInsensitive, .widthInsensitive, .forcedOrdering], range: nil, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US"))` (cross-check); values -1/0/1.

# ci_contains <haystack> <needle> -> A B : A = `haystack.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(needle)`, B = `haystack.range(of: needle, options: [.caseInsensitive], range: nil, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US")) != nil`; 0/1.
# graphemes <string> -> C S U16 U8 : C = `s.count` (Characters/extended grapheme clusters), S = `s.unicodeScalars.count`, U16 = `s.utf16.count`, U8 = `s.utf8.count`.
